messages:
anya: Quick async sync on Optimize toolkit delivery — need clear owners, blockers, and regression status before EOW. TL;DR: quant recommendations are in, batching patch needs infra signoff, caching introduced a staging regression. Please reply with ownership + ETA.

sam: I can own the batching infra signoff. PR: https://git.internal/rw/optkit/pulls/912 — waiting on perf job to finish, but initial runs look good. Will try to get signoff by tomorrow noon. :white_check_mark:

mike: I posted the quantization recommendations in the repo under docs/quant-profiles.md. There are 4 profiles (fast/low/standard/high-acc). Benchmarks on devbox show ~15-20% token cost reduction for small models, negligible quality loss on our eval sets.

li: Staging regression details: after enabling prefix KV caching we saw 95th latency spikes for embedding ingestion pipelines. Root cause seems to be eviction thrash + a bug in our async flush path. Issue filed: https://issues.internal/OPT-842 with logs. Repro steps included.

beth: Can we hold any model rollouts that depend on cache by default? I can add a rollout flag to the Helm chart today so teams can toggle caching per-deployment. Prefer to avoid prod exposure until fix.

sam: ACK, I'll block the auto-enable for batching-cached nodes until li's fix lands. Also pinging infra@ for the perf job: @mike infra, can you validate the runner config?

mike: on it. Runner config diff is small: `worker_count: 8 -> 12` and `batch_window_ms: 20 -> 15`. Putting a small smoke job in place now.

anya: Note on ownership: batching infra -> sam, quant profiles + docs -> mike, cache bug + fix -> li, rollout gating -> beth. I'll mark this in the delivery tracker. ETA requests: sam (tomorrow noon), li (end of day today for hotfix PR), mike (docs fine, can ship profiles), beth (helm flag by EOD).

li: Hotfix PR created: https://git.internal/rw/optkit/pulls/918. Hotfix changes the eviction threshold and adds metrics around async flush. Requesting quick CR.

sam: Reviewing PR 918 now. If green, I'll queue a canary deploy. Also FYI my batching PR 912 depends on an infra image bump (image->sha: a1b2c3) — will need eng-runtime to promote that image.

eng-runtime-bot: build 1.2.3 for image a1b2c3 passed smoke tests and is available in staging registry.

beth: Helm flag snippet to toggle caching (I'll add to chart):
```
cache:
  enabled: false  # set to true to enable on a per-deployment basis
  evictionThresholdPct: 65
```
I'll open a PR for the chart.

qa-bot: Regression suite run queued: test-run-id=qr-2410001. Expect results in ~45m. Will post failures.

mike: Quick note about quant profiles: recommend we ship fast + standard first; hold high-acc for canary where we can test quality. Also added a short script to convert profile -> model-override: `tools/convert_profile.sh standard mymodel`

anya: Action items summary: 1) sam -> batching infra signoff + promote image (ETA tomorrow noon). 2) li -> hotfix PR 918 (ETA EOD today). 3) beth -> helm toggle PR (ETA EOD). 4) mike -> finalize profile docs and convert script (done). 5) qa-bot -> share reg-suite results. I'll do a quick follow-up thread after QA results. Please add any missing dependencies. :eyes:

amy: (typo) meant to say @anya — nvm.

sam: got it. ping me if QA flags anything blocking.

li: FYI if anyone needs to reproduce the latency spike locally: run `./tools/run_embed_load.sh --concurrency 100 --cache-enabled true` and watch `metrics/cache/evictions`.

anya: Thanks all. If no further blockers after QA, plan to canary the batching + fixed caching tomorrow 13:00 PDT. :calendar:

(END)
